problem.title: Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid

approaches.title: Net parenthesis balance
approaches.summary: Computes the absolute final difference between opening and closing parentheses. This is incorrect because it does not account for invalid closing parentheses appearing before matching openings.

revisions.commitComment: naive solution, fails to account for order
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 921!: naive solution, fails to account for order
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduced a naive fold that returns the absolute net parenthesis balance. Marked incorrect because it ignores ordering.

approaches.title: Track unmatched parentheses
approaches.summary: Scans the string while tracking unmatched openings and immediately counting unmatched closing parentheses. The later revision preserves this strategy while expressing it as a functional fold.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaced net-balance counting with standard tracking of unmatched openings, unmatched closings, and required insertions.

revisions.commitComment: refactored into functional fold expression for fun
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 921: refactored into functional fold expression for fun
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Refactored the same tracking algorithm into a fold over a three-value state tuple without changing the core strategy.
